_purpose: THE authoritative register of every input to HCG's unit economics and to the runtime financial-policy DEFAULTS. Runtime modules (costModel, economicPolicy, unitEconomics, carrierComparison, pricingScenarios, productCatalog) read their defaults from here; tests/economics-register.test.mjs fails if any runtime default, the migration 067 SQL defaults/seeds or docs/finance/carrier-quotes.json drift from it. Changing a value here changes NO price, NO allowance and NO database policy: the database (fc_policy, fc_budget_profiles) stays authoritative for enforcement and is changed only through the audited functions. Explained in docs/finance/HCG_UNIT_ECONOMICS_V1.md.
currency: GBP unless the key says otherwise; all provider prices ex-VAT

statusKey.KNOWN: Verified from HCG's own billing/records, law, or HCG's own published terms
statusKey.CONFIGURED: A value currently set in HCG code, migrations or env defaults (a fact about the system, not about the world)
statusKey.ESTIMATED: A published list price, a reasoned assumption or a modelling convention; not verified against an HCG invoice
statusKey.UNKNOWN: No evidence either way; the value shown is a placeholder so the model can run
statusKey.PROVIDER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Public/list information exists but the rate HCG actually pays (or whether it applies) must be confirmed with the provider or from an invoice

kindKey.fact: Describes the world (a price, a rate, a law)
kindKey.policy: A choice HCG makes (margin target, reserve, allowance); placeholders until Andrew decides
kindKey.modelling: A convention needed to turn facts into a per-customer figure

priceIncVatGbp.note: APPROVED launch price (Andrew, 2026-10-04). Live providers (Stripe live Price, App Store IAP) remain £4.99 until the coordinated cutover (docs/launch/2026-10-05-PRICE-CUTOVER-CHECKLIST.md); terms.html updated in source 2026-10-05, not yet published.

vatRate.source: UK standard rate; AFMD Ltd is VAT-registered (GB379120684, public/terms.html)
vatRate.note: Stores (Apple/Google) account for UK VAT on in-app sales as deemed supplier; commission is modelled on the ex-VAT price.

stripeCardPct.source: Stripe UK public pricing, standard UK cards 1.5% + 20p
stripeCardPct.note: Non-UK/EEA/premium cards cost more; HCG's account pricing not read (live Stripe read denied 2026-09-30).

stripeCardFixedGbp.note: Dominates the Stripe fee at £5.99 (56% of it).

stripeBillingPct.source: Stripe Billing pay-as-you-go (0.7%; some secondary sources still quote 0.5%)
stripeBillingPct.note: Invoiced separately from the charge fee, so it is invisible in balance transactions.

stripeTaxPct.source: Stripe Tax 0.5% per transaction IF enabled
stripeTaxPct.note: Whether Stripe Tax is enabled is unverified; prices use tax_behavior=inclusive, which does not require it. Kept in (conservative).

appleStandardRate.note: Subscriptions drop to 15% after one year of paid service per subscriber.

appleSmallBusinessRate.note: HCG's enrolment is UNKNOWN. productCatalog defaults Apple to 30% until confirmed.

appleSmallBusinessEnrolled.source: No App Store Connect access (memory: Apple Build 12 investigation)
appleSmallBusinessEnrolled.note: Single largest Apple-channel unknown: 30% vs 15% moves the Apple safe budget by ~£0.75/month.

googlePlayServiceFeeRate.source: Google Play: 15% on auto-renewing subscriptions from day one (since 2022)
googlePlayServiceFeeRate.note: NOT APPLICABLE TODAY: no Play Billing product exists; Android subscribers pay via Stripe. Play Billing is likely required before Play Production (memory: Android Play Billing compliance).

revenueCatRateAboveThreshold.source: RevenueCat public pricing: free to $2,500 monthly tracked revenue, then 1%
revenueCatRateAboveThreshold.note: Applies to Apple (and future Google) subscribers only. £0 today (far below threshold).

revenueCatFreeMtrUsd.note: ≈ 525 Apple subscribers at £5.99 before any RevenueCat fee.

revenueLeakageRate.source: No refund/chargeback/failed-payment history (0 genuine paying customers as of 2026-09-27)
revenueLeakageRate.note: Refunds, chargebacks (Stripe dispute fee £20 each), failed renewals already served. 2% placeholder.

numberRentalGbpPerMonth.source: Twilio Pricing API + 45 billed number-months at exactly this rate (2026-09)
numberRentalGbpPerMonth.note: Billed per number held, whether or not the customer uses it.

numberPurchaseGbpCeiling.note: Containment's conservative charge per purchase; the observed cost is the first month's rental.

numberHeldAfterChurnMonths.source: Number lifecycle quarantine/grace (memory: number inventory; quarantine never auto-released before the 2026-09-30 clean-up)
numberHeldAfterChurnMonths.note: Rental paid on a churned customer's number until release.

monthlyChurnRate.note: Only used to spread churned-number rental over active customers.

twilioInboundGbpPerMin.source: Twilio Pricing API; real call CA43b447… 239 s billed 4 × £0.00756; Twilio Support (2026-09): billable for the whole connected call incl. <Dial><Client>
twilioInboundGbpPerMin.note: Applies to TRUSTED calls too: forwarding is unconditional (**21*) so every inbound minute crosses Twilio.

twilioAppLegBilledGbpPerMin.source: 100 <Dial><Client> legs with no price; calls-client usage category never appeared
twilioAppLegBilledGbpPerMin.note: Observation, not a contract: Twilio may start billing it.

twilioAppLegListUsdPerMin.source: Twilio public Voice SDK list price
twilioAppLegListUsdPerMin.note: Containment and costModel price the app leg at this list rate (conservative).

twilioSmsGbpPerSegment.note: Warning SMS = 1 segment; red-line/post-call/limit messages = 2 segments. Warning SMS currently fail (error 21661).

twilioOutboundUkMobileGbpPerMin.note: Not used by the current architecture (pre-23-Aug dial-back only). Outbound geo permissions all disabled 2026-09-30.

twilioPlatformFeesGbpPerMonth.source: Twilio billing history: only a £0.00152 failed-message fee ever

transcriptionUsdPerMin.note: The OpenAI project key cannot read costs: unverified against an invoice. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe lists at $0.003/min (not in use).

transcriptionAudioMultiplier.unit: audio minutes transcribed per monitored minute
transcriptionAudioMultiplier.source: speechSegmenter.js non-overlapping segments (e56e776, in production since eb43368); <Stream> default inbound_track only
transcriptionAudioMultiplier.note: Was 2.0 with the old 4 s/2 s overlap window.

usdToGbp.source: Convention used by costModel.js and carrierComparison.js
usdToGbp.note: research/carrier-routing-v2 used 0.75: a second, conflicting FX convention. Affects transcription and any USD carrier quote.

liveRiskScoringGbpPerMin.source: Rule-based scorer; no LLM on the live call path

aiClassifierGbpPerRequest.note: POST /process (gpt-4o-mini) is unreachable from Twilio today: £0 in the model.

openAiRetryMultiplier.note: Retries could multiply transcription cost by up to 3× on a bad day; no per-request cost data exists.

roundUpMinutesPerCall.source: pricingScenarios.js / carrierComparison.js (60/60 billing incl. ringing, observed calls)

streamRoundUpPerMonitoredCall.unit: extra stream minutes per monitored call

infrastructureFixedGbpPerMonth.source: Railway Hobby $5 + ~$0.95 usage (seen); Supabase very likely Pro $25+ (invoice unverified); Resend, IONOS/domain, Apple $99/yr, Google $25 once: UNKNOWN/unallocated
infrastructureFixedGbpPerMonth.note: Higgsfield $59/mo is marketing, not cost of service. Fixed: per-customer share falls with scale.

infrastructureAllocationGbpPerCustomer.note: Equals £40/month ÷ 160 customers. At 1,000 customers the true share is ~£0.04.

targetGrossMargin.source: Andrew's brief (~40%); ALLOWANCE_TARGET_MARGIN default; economicPolicy deliveryCostCeilingRatio = 1 − 0.4
targetGrossMargin.note: Gross margin here = (net revenue − payment/store fee − leakage − every per-customer cost of service) ÷ net revenue. Company overheads (staff, marketing) are NOT deducted.

topUpSafetyReserveRatio.note: A DIFFERENT reserve from the plan reserve (0.15). Intentional or not, it is now visible; DECISION.

fortressSeedBudgetGbp.source: migration 067 fc_budget_profiles seed (placeholders, DECISION D1); 067 not applied anywhere in production

fortressConnectedRateGbpPerMin.source: migration 067 fc_policy default = inbound £0.007558 + app leg at list £0.00316
fortressConnectedRateGbpPerMin.note: 42% above the cost actually billed today (£0.007558).

planAllowanceMinutes.note: Metered from Media Stream start: greeting + ringing + unanswered calls count.

ofcomAverageOutgoingMinutesPerMonth.note: Only an external anchor: HCG pays for INCOMING minutes, which Ofcom does not publish per user.
